rootReadback.object: DICTIONARY handle 0xC; each root CRC passes, decode succeeds with 0 main and 2 handle bits remaining
rootReadback.cloningAndHardOwner: both None for R13; no native default inferred

rootReadback.independenceLimit: Numeric handle value 0 is not a proof of its source wire role; the separate physical walker binds that role. Identical source and destination roots do not test collision merging or application validity.

ac1024Suffix.readerObservation: R2010, 275 header variables, complete true, trailer CRC/end sentinel true, 226/226 object-map entries observed.
ac1024Suffix.sourceReview: The parser bounds streams by the declared data size and checks the next CRC and sentinel; it returns without classifying the remaining logical section bytes. Therefore a successful read does not establish that the existing 739-byte post-sentinel suffix is safe to discard.
